def extract_symbols_from_item(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Set[str]:
    """Extract potential symbol names from checklist item text fields"""
    symbols = set()

    # Extract from title, test_procedure, notes
    title = item.get('title', '')
    procedure = item.get('test_procedure', '')
    notes = item.get('notes', '')

    # Look for common patterns:
    # 1. Function/method names (camelCase, snake_case)
    # 2. Type names (PascalCase)
    # 3. Variable names
    # 4. Keywords from test procedure

    combined_text = f"{title} {procedure} {notes}"

    # Extract quoted strings (often function/type names)
    quoted = re.findall(r'`([^`]+)`', combined_text)
    symbols.update(quoted)

    # Extract camelCase/PascalCase identifiers
    identifiers = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+(?:[A-Z][a-z]+)+\b', combined_text)
    symbols.update(identifiers)

    # Extract snake_case identifiers
    snake_case = re.findall(r'\b[a-z]+_[a-z_]+\b', combined_text)
    symbols.update(snake_case)

    # Extract common function-like patterns
    func_patterns = re.findall(r'(\w+)\s*\(', combined_text)
    symbols.update(func_patterns)

    technical_keywords = [

        'VerifyBlockSignature', 'ValidateBlock', 'ProcessExecution',
        'HandleIncomingBlock', 'SyncBlocks', 'ReceiveBlocks'
    ]

    for keyword in technical_keywords:
        if keyword.lower() in combined_text.lower():
            symbols.add(keyword)

    return {s for s in symbols if len(s) > 2}  # Filter out too-short symbols

    """Categorize item by consensus domain area"""
    title = item.get('title', '').lower()
    procedure = item.get('test_procedure', '').lower()
    combined = f"{title} {procedure}"

    if any(kw in combined for kw in ['p2p', 'network', 'peer', 'sync']):

    elif any(kw in combined for kw in ['block', 'execution', 'state transition']):
        return 'execution'
    elif any(kw in combined for kw in ['attestation', 'committee', 'validator']):
        return 'consensus'
    elif any(kw in combined for kw in ['fork', 'upgrade', 'transition']):
        return 'fork_choice'
    else:
        return 'general'

        domain = categorize_by_domain(item)

        all_symbols.update(symbols)

    print(f"Extracted {len(all_symbols)} unique symbols across all items")

    # Phase 2: Batch symbol resolution using Tree-sitter
    # Note: Since we already ran analyze_project, the project is analyzed
    # We would now use find_symbol or run_query in batches
